readings.Aries: Your capacity to begin is extraordinary. The question today is about depth, not speed. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Taurus: Your threshold for chaos is lower than most people's. This is a feature, not a flaw. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Gemini: You contain the answer. You keep looking for it outside because inside feels too committed. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Cancer: You are not responsible for managing the feelings of everyone around you. Just your own. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Leo: Someone who competed with you has moved on. You haven't. Notice this. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: There is a small pleasure available to you right now that your efficiency has been routing around. Take it. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Libra: You are diplomatic to a fault. The fault is visible to others even when you don't intend it. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Scorpio: You've been maintaining distance that was once necessary. The necessity has passed. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Sagittarius: The question you're asking is good. The answer you're expecting is limiting the search. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Capricorn: Your work ethic is not in question. Your relationship to rest is the variable. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Aquarius: Your vision of how things could be is accurate and inspiring. Today, things are how they are. Work with that. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Pisces: The grief hasn't finished moving through you. Let it continue. Let this one be easy.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
